_comment_cpu: 1 vCPU / 2 GB. The work is HTTP range reads from Planetary Computer, so it is network-bound: 12 reader threads spend most of their time waiting. The largest read cell is ~9 x 12 km, ~1.1 Mpx at 10 m, ~40 MB of arrays per thread at worst, ~500 MB for 12 threads. The backfill shards use this same definition with SAT_MODE/SAT_SHARD overrides.

containerDefinitions.name: surfaces
containerDefinitions._comment_image: The same image as every other job. It already carries rasterio, shapely, pyproj and numpy; the reader uses stdlib urllib for STAC, so no dependency was added to the pinned set.
containerDefinitions._comment_job: JOB is baked in, not passed as a schedule override: a lost override would otherwise run the SURFACES job. SAT_MODE defaults to daily for the same reason - only a deliberate run-task override makes this a backfill.
